python_comparison.source_observed: Published Python passes existing v._tensor objects into the native function, awaits one compiled binding call, then wraps native output arrays. NDArray.numpy normally returns shared views for contiguous supported types.
python_comparison.rust_observed: Owned Function.run reconstructs native arrays and copies outputs. Aether uses this for conditioner/time/modulation/decoders, but uses persistent Metal buffers for the body. Metal encode eagerly completes each call with extra stream/command-buffer fences and readiness getters. Worker submits owned operations through an mpsc queue and native adapter creates/joins Swift task contexts; no fixed sleep/poll timeout found.
python_comparison.unknown: Compiled Python extension scheduling/fence internals are opaque to this source audit. No same-model/same-options Python or Swift timing exists for this production render. Native runtime selection must be matched; wheelmacOS27 defaults to OS unless overridden, dev-path imports may choose bundled runtime without USE_OS_COREAI.
